text:
[Council File 26-1330]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (PARK – PADILLA) relative to the development of recommendations for a Measure FD Implementation and Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) Expansion Plan.
Recommendations for Council action:
INSTRUCT the LAFD, with the assistance of the City Administrative Officer (CAO), Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), Personnel Department and other City departments as necessary, to report to Council prior to November 3, 2026, with initial recommendations regarding a Measure FD Implementation and LAFD Expansion Plan, including:
Prioritization of investments that measurably increase operational capacity, and reduce emergency response times, including expanding sworn and civilian staffing, replacing aging apparatus, repairing and modernizing existing stations, constructing new stations in areas where most needed, strengthening air operations and wildland firefighting capabilities, and improving technology and communications systems. The report should speak to investments that can begin within 30, 60, 90, and 180 days, in addition to establishing priorities, timelines, funding requirements, and responsible departments for major projects and initiatives.
Identification of procurement and hiring barriers and strategies to accelerate delivery; and identifying available Federal, State, regional, and other funding that can leverage Measure FD revenues.
An operational and workforce plan establishing a baseline of LAFD staffing, deployable personnel, apparatus and ambulance availability, facilities, response times, Emergency Medical Services (EMS) demand, wildfire resources, and other measures of operational capacity; identification of gaps through recent Standards of Coverage analysis; hiring, training, retention and deployment targets to increase the number of firefighters, paramedics, civilian employees, dispatch personnel, mechanics, inspectors, pilots, and other personnel needed to expand operational capacity.
A capital and emergency preparedness plan prioritizing fire station construction and modernization, apparatus and vehicle replacement, fleet maintenance, EMS resources, wildfire preparedness, air operations, communications and technology, and other critical infrastructure and equipment, incorporating applicable after-action recommendations, including those from the January 2025 Pacific Palisades Fire.
An accountability and reporting framework establishing measurable goals for staffing, response times, EMS and apparatus availability, capital project delivery, wildfire preparedness, and other operational outcomes; maintaining a separate accounting of Measure FD revenues and expenditures to ensure compliance with maintenance-of-effort requirements; creating a publicly accessible implementation dashboard; and, requiring quarterly Council reporting and periodic audits of Measure FD revenues and expenditures.
INSTRUCT the LAFD to update and present the preliminary Measure FD Implementation and LAFD Expansion Plan recommendations to the City Council within 60 days of the passage of Measure FD, if applicable.
INSTRUCT the LAFD to update the Measure FD Implementation and LAFD Expansion Plan annually, as necessary, to reflect actual revenues, expenditures, staffing, project delivery, emergency demand, operational performance, and updated City planning and Standards of Coverage findings.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For, If Amended: Sylmar Neighborhood Council
(Budget and Finance Committee and Public Safety Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
